behaviour: Add TSDoc comments to the 8 static validator methods on KubernetesValidatorFunctions.
rules: 1. Document isValidApiVersion: checks that value is a valid apiVersion string on the form <suffix> or <prefix>/<suffix> (via CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidPrefixAndOrSuffix with '/'), where optional <prefix> is a valid RFC 1123 DNS subdomain (CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain: 1-253 chars of dot-separated DNS labels, each 1-63 lowercase ASCII alphanumeric chars [a-z0-9] starting and ending with [a-z0-9] and allowing internal hyphens '-') and <suffix> is 1-63 ASCII alphanumeric chars ([a-z0-9A-Z]+, rejecting hyphens, underscores, and dots).

2. Document isValidKind: checks that value is a valid kind string of 1-63 characters starting with an ASCII letter ([a-zA-Z]) followed by zero or more ASCII alphanumeric characters ([a-z0-9A-Z]*), rejecting leading digits, hyphens, punctuation, empty strings, strings over 63 chars, and non-strings.

3. Document isValidObjectName: checks that value is a valid object name string of 1-63 characters starting and ending with an ASCII alphanumeric character ([A-Za-z0-9]) with only ASCII alphanumeric characters, hyphens ('-'), underscores ('_'), and dots ('.') in between (/^([A-Za-z0-9][-A-Za-z0-9_.]*)?[A-Za-z0-9]$/), accepting uppercase letters and consecutive internal separators.

4. Document isValidNamespace: checks that value is a valid namespace string by delegating to {@link CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsLabel} (RFC 1123 DNS label: 1-63 lowercase ASCII alphanumeric characters [a-z0-9] and internal hyphens '-', starting and ending with [a-z0-9], rejecting uppercase letters, underscores, and dots).

5. Document isValidLabelKey: checks that value is a valid label key string on the form <name> or <prefix>/<name> (via CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidPrefixAndOrSuffix with '/'), where optional <prefix> is a valid DNS subdomain (CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain, 1-253 chars) and <name> is a valid object name (KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName, 1-63 chars).

6. Document isValidLabelValue: checks that value is a valid label value string, accepting either an empty string ('') or a valid object name (KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName, 1-63 chars).

7. Document isValidAnnotationKey: checks that value is a valid annotation key string on the form <name> or <prefix>/<name> (via CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidPrefixAndOrSuffix with '/'), where optional <prefix> is a valid DNS subdomain (CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain, 1-253 chars) and <name> is a valid object name (KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName, 1-63 chars), using the same rule as isValidLabelKey.

8. Document isValidAnnotationValue: checks that value is a valid annotation value, accepting any string (typeof value === 'string') including an empty string '' with no length or character restrictions.
9. Include '@param value - The value to check' on each method and do not add @public tags to the static methods.
